conversationalUkrainian.title: Conversational Ukrainian
conversationalUkrainian.description: Master everyday speaking with real dialogues, pronunciation perfection, and confidence in social situations. Learn colloquial phrases, idioms, and the rhythm of natural speech. Perfect for travelers, new residents, and anyone who wants to actually *sound* Ukrainian. Lessons adapt to your interests — whether that's food, culture, history, or just surviving small talk.

professionalUkrainian.title: Professional & Business Ukrainian
professionalUkrainian.description: From formal emails to business meetings, pitch your ideas in Ukrainian with polish and precision. Ideal for professionals relocating to Ukraine, expats working with Ukrainian colleagues, or anyone building a career connection to Ukrainian-speaking markets. We cover terminology, etiquette, and the unwritten rules of professional Ukrainian culture.

examPrep.title: Exam Prep & Structured Learning
examPrep.description: Preparing for the Ukrainian state language exam (for citizenship or public service), moving to Ukraine, or need a formal curriculum? I design structured lessons with clear milestones, grammar foundations, and steady progress. Every lesson builds on the last. You'll receive homework, progress tracking, and the confidence to sit any Ukrainian language exam.

russianLessons.title: Russian Lessons
russianLessons.description: Master Russian with a native speaker. From complete beginner to advanced fluency — personalized lessons that make Russian click.

poetryTranslation.title: Poetry Translation
poetryTranslation.description: I translate poetry between Ukrainian, Russian, and English — carrying not just the words but the rhythm, the feeling, and the soul of what was written. Because a poem that doesn't move you isn't a poem anymore.

creativeWriting.title: Creative Writing
creativeWriting.description: From brand copy to original poetry, from social media content to song lyrics — if it involves words, I'm in. I write in three languages and bring a multilingual ear to everything I create.
